title: Database integrity gaps around outcome/status/hindsight
desc: The database allows outcome set with partial hindsight, hindsight scores while status is ACTIVE, and status DONE with no outcome, and the existing CHECK constraints live only in raw SQL invisible to schema.prisma.
note: The API path is tighter than the DB: src/lib/validation.ts:40-47 outcomeSchema requires status DONE|ABANDONED plus outcome plus all four hindsight scores together, and no API route can clear outcome (ideaUpdateSchema, validation.ts:30-38, has no outcome field), so the 'outcome removed leaves hindsig
ev: prisma/schema.prisma:41-47 declares outcome/outcomeRecordedAt/hDifferentiation/hEvidence/hCost/hReversibility all as plain nullable columns with no constraint. prisma/migrations/20260917213700_score_checks/migration.sql:2-10 adds only range CHECKs ('hDifferentiation' IS NULL OR BETWEEN 1 AND 5 etc.) - nothing ties outcome to hindsight or to status. Those CHECKs exist only in the hand-written SQL; schema.prisma has no matching declaration.

title: Ownership is checked in a separate read before an unscoped update
desc: Routes call findFirst({id,userId}) and then update({where:{id}}) without repeating the ownership filter on the write.
note: The pre-check does scope ownership today, so there is no current IDOR; the concrete exposure is the unhandled P2025/500 on a concurrent delete.
ev: src/app/api/ideas/[id]/route.ts:25 'const existing = await prisma.idea.findFirst({ where: { id, userId: user.id } });' then :37-40 'const idea = await prisma.idea.update({ where: { id }, data: parsed.data, });'. Same split at :50/:53 (DELETE), src/app/api/ideas/[id]/outcome/route.ts:14/:26, src/app/api/ideas/[id]/share/route.ts:15/:24 and :38/:41. No try/catch anywhere in src/app/api (grep -rn 'try {' src/app/api/ -> none), so a P2025 from the update propagates.

title: Origin and Content-Type not checked on state-changing routes
desc: req.json() called regardless of Content-Type; SameSite=Lax blocks most cross-site cookie use but a cross-site text/plain form POST can still hit unauthenticated login/register.
note: SameSite=Lax protects already-authenticated state-changing routes, but login/register are unauthenticated, so Lax does not block a cross-site login-CSRF; whether a text/plain form POST is accepted depends on browser/runtime behaviour not settleable from the repo.
ev: src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts:8 'const body = await req.json().catch(() => null);' - same pattern at register/route.ts:8, ideas/route.ts:34, ideas/[id]/route.ts:28, outcome/route.ts:17, share/route.ts:18. grep for headers.get / Origin / Content-Type across src/app/api/ and src/proxy.ts (excluding the client-side request header) -> 'none found'. No CSRF token anywhere. src/lib/session.ts:18 sameSite: "lax".

title: Account enumeration via register/login responses
desc: An unknown email returns 401 immediately while a known email runs bcrypt first, revealing registered emails by timing; register also returns an explicit 409 for existing emails.
note: The claim is filed against register/route.ts:20-25, which covers only the 409 half; the timing oracle it describes lives in login/route.ts:19-27.
ev: src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts:19-25 'const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } }); if (existing) { return NextResponse.json({ error: "An account with that email already exists" }, { status: 409 }); }' - the explicit 409 is exactly at the cited lines. The timing side is in a different file: src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts:19-22 returns 401 before any bcrypt work when the user is unknown, and only :24 'const valid = await verifyPassword(password, user.passwordHash);' runs bcrypt (cost 12 per src/lib/auth.ts:21) for a known email.

title: getCurrentUser loads passwordHash on every request
desc: The user lookup has no select clause, so it returns passwordHash on every page render via the layout header.
note: No current response serializes the User object: site-header.tsx:20 renders only user.email, and src/app/api/auth/me/route.ts:8 explicitly selects { id, email, name } - the hash is loaded but not emitted today.
ev: src/lib/session.ts:40 'const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.sub } });' with no select, returning the full User row including passwordHash (prisma/schema.prisma:19). src/app/layout.tsx:28 renders <SiteHeader />, and src/components/site-header.tsx:6 'const user = await getCurrentUser();', so it runs on every page render.

title: JWT verification is not pinned
desc: jwtVerify pins no algorithms, issuer or audience, and the email claim is embedded in the token but never revalidated against the database.
note: getSecretKey (auth.ts:12) returns a Uint8Array, and jose restricts a symmetric key to HMAC algorithms, so the classic alg-confusion (RS256/none) attack is not available here; iss/aud are moot in a single-issuer app.
ev: src/lib/auth.ts:44 'const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, getSecretKey());' - no third options argument, so no algorithms/issuer/audience pinning. src/lib/auth.ts:32-37 never calls setIssuer/setAudience either. The email claim is read back at :45-48 but src/lib/session.ts:40 looks the user up by session.sub only, never comparing the claim to the DB row.

title: Sessions cannot be revoked
desc: Sessions are stateless 30-day JWTs with logout only clearing the browser cookie, and there is no reset, change-password or email verification flow.
ev: src/lib/auth.ts:5 'const SESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30; // 30 days' used at :36 setExpirationTime and src/lib/session.ts:20 maxAge. src/lib/session.ts:24-27 'export async function clearSessionCookie() { const store = await cookies(); store.delete(SESSION_COOKIE); }' - the only logout action; src/app/api/auth/logout/route.ts:4-7 just calls it. No session/token table in prisma/schema.prisma and no denylist anywhere. find src/app/api -type d shows no password-reset, change-password or verify route.

ev: src/lib/prisma.ts:9-11 `new PrismaClient({ log: process.env.NODE_ENV === "development" ? ["error", "warn"] : ["error"], });`. Command: `grep -rn 'console\.|logger|pino|winston' src/` -> no matches at all. The 401 at src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts:21 and :26 and the 409 at register/route.ts:21-24 return without recording anything.
